description: List search. The query is split on whitespace into words; an empty or whitespace-only query matches everything (even with no fields). Otherwise EVERY word must appear as a substring of AT LEAST ONE field (words may match different fields). Query and fields are compared ignoring case and diacritics (accents and cedilla folded, e.g. 'ção' == 'cao'). Swift: SearchFilter.matches(query, fields), folding with String.folding([.caseInsensitive, .diacriticInsensitive], locale pt_BR).
